# Governance Summary

## Proven Lifecycle Workflow
Phase 1 established and validated the constitutional workflow:

Authorization

↓

Implementation

↓

Independent Certification

↓

Integration

↓

Production Tag

↓

Freeze

↓

Lifecycle Closure

## Standardization
This workflow is now the required lifecycle standard for future compiler phases.

## Governance Constraints
- No implementation proceeds without authorization.
- No integration proceeds without independent certification.
- No phase progression proceeds without frozen baselines and lifecycle closure.
